Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Is Airplane Mode enabled?
- Do you see any signal bars at all, or does it say “No Service” or “No SIM”?
- Is there any other icon or message at the top of your screen?

If you’re not sure, I can guide you through some steps to check these settings. Let me know what you see, or if you’d like step-by-step instructions.
Actually, after rebooting, my status bar now shows excellent signal bars, 5G, data enabled, and connected to Chestnut-5G. Is there anything else I should check to make sure service is fully restored?

That’s great news! If your status bar now shows excellent signal, 5G, and data enabled, your cellular service is fully restored. You should be able to make calls, use mobile data, and send/receive messages as normal.

To confirm everything is working:
- Try making a call or sending a text message.
- Try browsing the internet with Wi-Fi turned off to test mobile data.
- If you use picture/video messaging (MMS), try sending a photo.

If all these functions work, your service is fully restored. If you encounter any specific issues (such as problems with MMS or data), let me know and I can help you troubleshoot further. Otherwise, you’re all set!

I just tried sending a picture message and it went through without any issues. The internet is working great and all calls and texts are fine. Everything appears to be fully restored now—thank you for your help!

You’re very welcome! I’m glad to hear that your service, internet, and picture messaging are all working perfectly now. If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
